sequential_acquisition.sequential_acquis.reason: Each step proceeds in order: the acquisition is prepared from the surrogate holding only observed (x, y); a response-blind candidate set is built from the current prefix; one point is selected and evaluated; the surrogate is updated. Random and grid sequences come from an RNG or from geometry, not from responses. I independently rebuilt candidate sets from logged prefixes X[:n]. The logged selected point at step n lies exactly in that set at every checked step (planar n = 10, 11, 25, 60, 150, 300, 499; 3-D n = 10, 200, 700, 999). Every record carries the logged sequential-integrity flags, and nothing indicates future ground truth guiding acquisition.

integrity.originality.no_substantive_rep.reason: CETV's claimed contribution is observation-gated selection of structural 'error teachers': an additive spectral fit, an axis-affine tree, a signed-LOO local-GP committee, or a physical polynomial. Their disagreement with a fixed ordinary-Kriging reporter, calibrated to LOO residuals, is multiplied by nearest-sample volume. The paper positions this against the cited cross-validation and global-accuracy criteria (SFCVT, MEPE, TEAD), integrated-variance and information criteria, and local nonstationary emulation. Established methods (MEPE, TEAD) were run only as labelled diagnostics and explicitly not claimed as contributions. The general ingredients (CV error, committee disagreement, volume weighting) belong to known families, but I identified no specific prior method that CETV substantively reproduces and presents as new. This assessment is limited to my own knowledge, since web search was not available.
